server_requests_description_admin: Users ask for new MCP servers from their agent through Obot's built-in MCP server. Approve a request to add the server to the catalog and a vMCP.
server_requests_description_user: MCP servers you asked an administrator to add. Ask for one from your agent through Obot's built-in MCP server.
server_requests_no_shared_vmcps: There are no shared vMCPs yet. Create a new one.
server_requests_new_vmcp_access: Administrators and the requester get access to the new vMCP.
server_requests_approved_result: Added to the catalog and to {vmcp}.
server_requests_requester_no_access: The requester can't connect to this vMCP: none of its profiles grant them access. Add them to a profile on the vMCP.
server_requests_setup_title: Obot MCP server for your agents
server_requests_setup_description: Add this MCP server to Claude or any MCP client. It searches the servers Obot provides and requests new ones.
server_requests_setup_admin_description: Push it to every Claude user with managed settings. The admin server, for administrators only, reviews requests from an agent.
server_requests_slack_hint: Set OBOT_SERVER_MCP_SERVER_REQUEST_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL to a Slack incoming webhook to alert administrators about new requests.
